_about: Curated public-domain plot-twist gold set (H5 ceiling). Each story is fetched from Project Gutenberg by `gutenberg_id` (a collection volume) and extracted by its title heading. `status`: ready = id verified by title-line probe (still confirm word_count on fetch); needs_verify = id/collection not yet pinned (fill in, or let the fetcher resolve via gutendex where available); unavailable = likely not on PG in a PD English text. `translation` records the PD translation for non-English originals. See docs/tracks/plot_twist/pd_gold_set.md for twist summaries and fetch methodology.
